column3: Repeats divine guidance by divine choosing, with loss of guidance as its contrary.
Places guidance on a straight path, specifying its sustained direction.
Directly joins shirk to the nullification of a prophet's deeds.
Divine choosing concerns provision here, not the guidance or shirk claim.
Begins the lineage passage by showing guidance granted individually across generations.
